description: OrioleDB (containerised PostgreSQL storage engine) topology and options.

fields.description: Tag of the orioledb/orioledb image; the pgNN suffix picks the PostgreSQL major the engine is patched into.
fields.name: image_tag
fields.title: Image tag

fields.description: Use the -ubuntu flavor of the tag instead of the default Alpine one; needed when the workload wants glibc locales.
fields.name: ubuntu_base
fields.title: Ubuntu base image

fields.description: Physical async standbys; OrioleDB has no supported failover manager, so these never get promoted automatically.
fields.name: replicas
fields.title: Streaming replicas

fields.description: HAProxy instances in front of the master (and read-only backends for the replicas).
fields.name: haproxy
fields.title: HAProxy nodes

fields.description: shared_buffers for the container; OrioleDB uses it as its primary page pool, so it should dominate the machine's RAM.
fields.name: shared_buffers_mb
fields.title: Shared buffers

fields.description: Locale passed to initdb inside the container; C.UTF-8 keeps collation cheap and image-independent.
fields.name: initdb_locale
fields.title: initdb locale

fields.description: Set default_table_access_method = orioledb so unqualified CREATE TABLE lands on the OrioleDB engine rather than heap.
fields.name: default_table_access_method
fields.title: OrioleDB by default

fields.description: SQL executed on the master once the container is healthy, before the workload.
fields.name: init_sql
fields.title: Init SQL

rules.message: HAProxy in front of a single node only adds a hop
a replica set with a tiny page pool measures the disk, not the engine
